title: Typed Config Loader
prompt: Write `loadConfig(env)` that converts raw env strings into a typed config object: port (number, default 3000 when absent), databaseUrl (string), debug (boolean — true only for exactly the string "true"), and features (array from a comma-separated FEATURES value; absent => []). Throw on a non-numeric PORT rather than silently defaulting.

tests.name: coerces types with the documented rules
tests.hint: Number(), === "true", split(",") — each field states its own rule.

tests.name: defaults without lying
tests.hint: Defaults are part of the contract — they must be explicit and consistent.

tests.name: rejects garbage instead of guessing
tests.hint: Number("eight-thousand") is NaN — catch it and say which field broke.
